checks.stdout_tail:
usage: result.py [-h] [--adata-path ADATA_PATH_DASH]
                 [--adata_path ADATA_PATH_UNDER] [--data_path DATA_PATH_FLAG]
                 [--data DATA_FLAG] [--val-adata-path VAL_ADATA_PATH_DASH]
                 [--val_data VAL_DATA] [--val-path VAL_PATH]
                 [--val_path VAL_PATH_UNDER]
                 [--val_adata_path VAL_ADATA_PATH_UNDER]
                 [--output-metrics OUTPUT_METRICS_DASH]
                 [--metrics-path METRICS_PATH]
                 [--metrics_path METRICS_PATH_UNDER] [--output OUTPUT]
                 [--seed SEED] [--epochs EPOCHS] [--max-genes MAX_GENES]
                 [data_path]

Train a perturbation-response model on single-cell data and write validation
metrics as JSON.

positional arguments:
  data_path             Path to training AnnData (.h5ad).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --adata-path ADATA_PATH_DASH
  --adata_path ADATA_PATH_UNDER
  --data_path DATA_PATH_FLAG
  --data DATA_FLAG
  --val-adata-path VAL_ADATA_PATH_DASH
  --val_data VAL_DATA
  --val-path VAL_PATH
  --val_path VAL_PATH_UNDER
  --val_adata_path VAL_ADATA_PATH_UNDER
  --output-metrics OUTPUT_METRICS_DASH
  --metrics-path METRICS_PATH
  --metrics_path METRICS_PATH_UNDER
  --output OUTPUT
  --seed SEED
  --epochs EPOCHS
  --max-genes MAX_GENES
